name: Codex-X
description: OpenAI Codex 桌面端/CLI 的可视化管理工具，具有Provider/API 切换、会话同步、提示词注入、Skills/MCP 管理、TOML 配置可视化的跨平台工具。
one_liner: A desktop app that gives you visual buttons and menus for managing your OpenAI Codex CLI settings — API keys, prompt templates, sessions — instead of hand-editing config files.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev studio in China juggling multiple AI coding API providers and client accounts who is tired of manually editing TOML config files.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer managing several clients' separate API keys and prompt setups switches between them with one click instead of editing config files per project.
A small dev studio standardizes prompt templates across the team so every developer uses the same vetted, tested prompts.
A power user resells curated prompt template packs to other Codex CLI users through the app's template sync feature.

money_ideas.idea: Sell curated, tested prompt template packs as an in-app one-time purchase.
Offer a 'pro' tier with team-sharing of provider configs and templates for small dev studios.

steal_this: This is a niche power-user utility for people already using Codex CLI — the realistic move is translating/localizing it for a non-Chinese audience and offering setup support, not building a new company around it.
